the balanceOf result is checked for non-zero in multiple mode.

the product token reference feeds the ERC721 transferFrom call.

the ERC721 handle holds the contract on which transferFrom is invoked.
ownerOf result is validated before selling a single token.

msg.sender is the recipient of the ERC721 transferFrom call.

the receiver hook executes attacker-controlled code that can re-enter purchaseProduct before state is refreshed.

normalization_plan.reason: withdrawAmount is only consumed as the argument of the ERC20 transfer unsafe operation.
createProduct.slug is only used as the mapping key inside createProduct.
price is only stored/served by createProduct and belongs to that function.
tokenId is only used for ownership validation inside createProduct.
contractAddress is only wrapped into the ERC721 handle inside createProduct.
multiple only branches the validation logic inside createProduct.
the product memory copy is a transient local of createProduct.
createProduct.tokenContract exists solely to perform the ownerOf/balanceOf calls.
tokenOwner holds the ownerOf return value used for custody validation.
balance holds the balanceOf return value used in multiple mode.
deleteProduct.slug is only used as the mapping key inside deleteProduct.
purchaseProduct.slug is only used as the mapping key inside purchaseProduct.
the purchased product memory copy is a transient local of purchaseProduct.
purchaseProduct.tokenContract is only used to invoke the ERC721 transferFrom call.
the selected tokenId is only used as an argument to the ERC721 transferFrom call.
tokenOwner is a validation local scoped to purchaseProduct.
newShopManager is the sole assignment target inside setShopManager.
contractAddress is the sole assignment target inside setToken.
